role: perfect-information suffix feasibility under actual stocks and locked nominations; no new controller
registration_context: V3, V4 and both reserve-component outcomes known; suffix LP outcomes unobserved

roster.selection_basis: original fixed reference, avoiding changes in forecast-profile shape; all its windows retained
roster.development: original April/July/October 2024 samples and all 73 complete windows per sample

trace_validation: only add snapshot metadata; each reference success flag and first failing minute must reproduce its saved V3/V4 row before any LP interpretation

probes.current: for each failed reference window, use the nomination decision associated with its first failure: floor(failure_minute/30)*30-60
probes.previous: also use the immediately preceding decision 30 minutes earlier; if current is the initial decision, retain an explicit no_previous_decision label
probes.initial_state: actual two-unit stocks at the probed decision, not a new half-full reset
probes.locked_commitments: fix the first two half-hour unit nominations to the already submitted pending powers; the nomination being considered at the probed decision and all later nominations are free
probes.horizon: from the probed decision to the same original window end, with all original future BOAs known to the diagnostic LP
probes.physical_contract: unchanged capacities, efficiencies, per-unit inventory bounds, shared gross execution power, signed nominations and BOA precedence
probes.solver: inherit the original physical oracle's HiGHS tolerances and 20-second per-probe limit
probes.replay: every feasible suffix must pass independent signed-power replay from the actual initial stocks, including equality to both locked pending nominations

interpretation.current_feasible: a different new nomination and later schedule could still recover with perfect information; this does not show an observable causal correction
interpretation.previous_feasible_current_infeasible: recoverability was lost between these two snapshots under the realized workload and locked commitments
interpretation.both_infeasible: recovery was already unavailable at the preceding probe; this does not locate its earliest loss
interpretation.unresolved: retain LP timeout/failure and replay discrepancies separately; never relabel them as infeasibility

limitations: reference-policy development diagnosis only; full future information never enters the tested controls; no global online-impossibility, candidate-library coverage, measured battery or source-benefit claim
